name: motion-soft-rise
title: Soft Rise
description: Khối chữ trồi lên 24 px, hết nhoè 8 px và rõ dần cùng lúc trong 0.9 giây.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Text block: y +24 → 0 px, blur 8 → 0 px and opacity 0 → 1 together in 900 ms sine.out (bezier .61,1,.88,1). Exit: fade 350 ms sine.in, no move. Tips: 16–28 px of travel, 4–10 px of blur; the blur may clear just before the move ends. Params: duration (0.9 s) · y: quãng trồi (24 px) · blur (8 px) · ease (sine.out).
